notes.title: End of Halloween event + Back to main menu button added!
notes.notes:
Changes in this small update are:
-The Halloween update has been removed
-Added a ¨Back to main menu¨ button at the end of every wave so you can go back to the menu whenever you want.

Thank you to all the people who played the halloween event, stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: HALLOWEEN EVENT!
notes.notes:
Halloween event! Only avaible during this week!
Only during the event:
-The asteroids were replaces by spooky pumpkins!
-The music from the levels was changed to a bit more creepy music.

Im already working on the next 2 levels, hope you enjoy this update and thank you for supporting the game!

notes.title: [Minor bug fix]
notes.notes: Fixed a bug in the bosses only level, where the boss of the first level did not appear

notes.title: New Level Update!
notes.notes:
New Level has been added to the game!

Changes of this update are:[list]
[*] 4 New enemies [Including a new type of enemy, the heavy gunner, with more cannons and twice the HP as the normal Fighter, but he is also bigger and slower]
[*] 1 New boss
[*] 30 minutes more of gameplay
[*] The new level was added to level 4, and the bosses only level was moved to level 5
[*] The new boss was also added to the bosses only level
[*] The new enemies are from a different planet so they also feature different looking projectiles like all the others
[/list]

I hope you enjoy this update!

Thank you for your support !

- Highground Games
